meta.source: proposal.md · AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景 · 场景卡表
meta.note_zh: 场景为概念建议/参考方案，供专业团队深化研究，非已建成或已部署项目。
meta.note_en: Scenes are conceptual proposals for further professional study, not built or deployed facilities.

scenes.desc_zh: 面向高校、开源社区和初创团队，提供成果发布、代码贡献展示和小型路演空间
scenes.desc_en: For universities, open-source communities and startups: release events, code-contribution showcases and small roadshows

scenes.desc_zh: 将标准制定、安全评测、模型红队测试转译为可参观、可预约、可监管的展示和协作节点
scenes.desc_en: Turns standard-setting, safety evaluation and model red-teaming into visitable, bookable, auditable display and collaboration nodes

scenes.desc_zh: 与公共服务、企业服务和低碳能源策略结合，作为待深化的新型基础设施原型
scenes.desc_en: Combined with public services, enterprise services and low-carbon energy, as a prototype of new infrastructure to be deepened

scenes.desc_zh: 用可解释导视和低侵入传感帮助识别慢行断点、拥挤节点和无障碍需求
scenes.desc_en: Uses explainable wayfinding and low-intrusion sensing to identify slow-mobility gaps, congestion points and accessibility needs

scenes.desc_zh: 服务智能体、智能终端和内容消费企业的展示、洽谈、媒体发布和国际交流
scenes.desc_en: Display, negotiation, media launch and international exchange for agent, smart-terminal and content-consumption enterprises

scenes.desc_zh: 把绿色空间、雨洪、步行骑行和AI展示结合，作为园区公共客厅
scenes.desc_en: Combines green space, stormwater, walking/cycling and AI display as the campus public living room

scenes.desc_zh: 面向高校成果转化，组织孵化、展示、法务、知识产权和投融资服务
scenes.desc_en: For university commercialization: incubation, display, legal, IP and investment/financing services

scenes.desc_zh: 以合规、授权、可审计为前提，展示数据要素和数字资产流通的城市服务界面
scenes.desc_en: Under compliance, authorization and auditability, a city-service interface for data-factor and digital-asset circulation

scenes.desc_zh: 将医疗、教育、法律、生活服务等AI+场景落到可运营的小尺度街区空间
scenes.desc_en: Lands medical, education, legal and living-service AI+ scenarios in operable small-scale street space

scenes.desc_zh: 形成从遗址文化、开源社区、产业展示到国际路演的可步行、可传播体验路线
scenes.desc_en: A walkable, shareable experience route from heritage culture, open-source community and industry display to international roadshows
